items.title: 33.5 Effect of Water Pollution on the Environment (pani ki pollution ka mahol par asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.5 (PDF 255-256); the biomagnification drawing is our own. Quick Check answers were written for the lesson and need review.

blocks.text: Pollutants pani ki physical aur chemical properties badal dete hain, jis se paudon aur janwaron ka zinda rehna mushkil ho jata hai. Environment (mahol) par aam asraat yeh hain: loss of biodiversity (jaandaron ki qismon ka nuqsan), habitat destruction (rehne ki jagahon ki tabahi), food chains ka bigarna aur pani ki quality ka girna.
